create_standard_scaler: create a StandardScaler to fit and transform input data using mean and standard deviation normalization
create_minmax_scaler: create a MinMaxScaler to fit and transform input data to a range between -1 and 1
run_scipy_refinement: run ScipyRefinement with BFGS or Nelder-Mead to optimize symbolic regression equation constants using scipy minimize
run_lsq_refinement: run LSQRefinement to optimize symbolic regression equation constants using scipy least squares fitting
run_nevergrad_refinement: run NevergradRefinement to optimize symbolic regression equation constants using multiple nevergrad optimizers in parallel
